audit.whatIsWrong: Text calls Rune Prison a flat root everywhere. Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and SLOWS; it only roots if Flux (Spell Flux, E) is already on the target.
audit.why: The decisive lane interaction is the E-then-W order. Dodging Spell Flux downgrades the W to a slow, which changes every step-up decision.
audit.corrected: State that Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux, cite 11s W cooldown at rank 1, and note Overload resets off his other casts (Q 5s base, E 3.5s at rank 1).
sources: kit Ryze W/E/Q text and cooldowns
